body: Revision 4 planning decision from the person: use the standard catalog (General, Plan Forge, Delivery, Audit / Red Team, Research / Creative, Custom); Plan Forge requires six distinct acolytes covering UI/UX, implementation engineering, delivery/Scrum, security, quality, and architecture/team lead; acolytes submit independent findings, while the Magos synthesizes and edits the target draft and may Save only after an approved Allow save petition.
